db.drive.l2.judul: Create an office folder in Google Drive
db.drive.l2.isi:
Put in only what the team may read: sales data, product photos, briefs, SOPs. Other files in your Drive stay closed. In the folder, tap ⋮ → Copy link.

Leave the sharing setting as is, keep it "Restricted". The team gets in through your own Google account (step 1), not through the link. Folder owned by another Google account? Share it to your Google account as Editor first.
